rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something subordinate to a primary matter or of lower importance.

example.english: These are secondary issues; the most important thing is to treat the patient first.
example.traditional: 呢啲係次要問題，最緊要係先處理病人。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 ci3 jiu3 man6 tai4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 sin1 cyu2 lei5 beng6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for secondary-school education, schools, students, or anything at that school level.

example.english: My daughter is entering secondary school this year, and she has to take a lot of books to school every day.
example.traditional: 我個女今年升中學，日日都要帶好多書返學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi2 gam1 nin4 sing1 zung1 hok6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 daai3 hou2 do1 syu1 faan1 hok6

rows.note: Use this medical term when a disease or condition is caused by or follows another disease.

example.english: This rash is a secondary reaction that appeared after the infection.
example.traditional: 呢種皮疹係感染之後出現嘅繼發性反應。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 pei4 can2 hai6 gam2 jim5 zi1 hau6 ceot1 jin6 ge3 gai3 faat3 sing3 faan2 jing3
